insight: The InboundGroupSessionData interface changed between matrix-js-sdk v34 and v38. The old version had `session_id`, `session_key`, `sender_key`, `forwarding_curve25519_key_chain`, and `keys_claimed` fields. The v38 version has `room_id`, `session`, `forwardingCurve25519KeyChain`, `keysClaimed?`, `untrusted?`, and `sharedHistory?` fields. The test data had to be updated to match the new shape.

matrix-js-sdk@38 on Node aborts (WASM `RuntimeError: unreachable`, exit 1) when `client.initRustCrypto()` is called with the SDK default `useIndexedDB:true`, because Node has no `indexedDB` global. This is a hard WASM abort, NOT a catchable JS exception: `try`/`catch`, `--unhandled-rejections`, and `NODE_OPTIONS` all fail to stop it. The fix is prevention, not handling: call `initRustCrypto({ useIndexedDB: false })` (in-memory store; works on Node but keys are NOT durable) and only when E2EE is explicitly opted in (`adapter.json encryption: true`, default false). Also: `createClient({ cryptoStore })` is legacy-crypto/migration-only in v38 — it does NOT persist Rust-crypto E2EE keys, so `SqliteCryptoStore` + `dataPath` does not make E2EE keys survive restart. Verified against the installed SDK (client.d.ts:91-96, 1104; client.js:1087).

DRONE-GW-BUG-002: a persistent Matrix sync store must ACCUMULATE /sync responses, not store the last one. A /sync response is a delta (the first carries room state, later ones carry only next_batch), so `INSERT OR REPLACE` of the last response leaves a valid token with no `rooms` — the client then resumes an incremental sync, getRooms() is empty, and replies fail with "unknown conversation" (persistence becomes WORSE than no store, which would full-sync). Fix mirrors matrix-js-sdk's IndexedDB backend: hold a `SyncAccumulator`, persist `getJSON(true)` (accumulated), return `getJSON()`/`getNextBatchToken()` from it, and rehydrate by replaying persisted state through `accumulate(..., fromDatabase=true)`. Note the gateway's `SqliteSyncStore` reads the DB directly (it never awaited `store.startup()`), so hydration must be lazy; also `createClient({cryptoStore})` being legacy-only (BUG-001) means the sync store and crypto store are independent.

drone-gateway Matrix adapter follow-on (after the sync-store accumulation fix): with a persistent sync store, matrix-js-sdk replays the cached /sync on restart and re-emits every cached timeline event as `RoomEvent.Timeline`. `EventTimelineSet.addLiveEvent` ALWAYS passes `toStartOfTimeline === false`, so `toStartOfTimeline` does NOT distinguish replayed history. The only discriminator is `data.liveEvent` (false when the event came `fromCache`). The adapter filtered on `toStartOfTimeline` alone, so on each restart it re-dispatched historical commands as fresh input — an earlier command's reply then "answered" a later unrelated command, and command replies duplicated once per restart. Fix: take the full 5-arg `RoomEvent.Timeline` signature `(event, room, toStartOfTimeline, removed, data)` and return early on `removed || !data?.liveEvent` (this is the SDK's own documented check, per event-timeline-set docs). Rule: with a persistent store, treat `RoomEvent.Timeline` as "timeline changed", not "new message".
